name: Hime-sama Love Life! -Motto! Ichaicha ☆ Paradise!-
original_name: 姫様LOVEライフ！ -もーっと！イチャイチャ☆ぱらだいす！-
source: The sequel to [url=/v16846]Hime-sama Love Life![/url] Yahiro is now in a relationship with your favorite heroines. Choose a heroine and read the conclusion to her scenario. Now that you’re a couple, it’s time to have a baby. It’s heart pounding, exciting sex filled baby making life with your favorite princess!
translation: [url=/v16846]《公主大人的戀愛生活！》[/url]的續作。八尋如今已和你喜歡的女主角成為戀人。選定一位女主角，看看專屬於她的故事最後如何收尾。既然已經成雙成對，接下來就該考慮生孩子了。和心愛的公主一起盡情享受讓人心跳加速的刺激性愛，努力做人吧！
